title: Hickory DNS hickory-net 0.26.0-beta.1 before 0.26.2 and hickory-proto 0.24.0 through 0.26.0-alpha.1 compare DNSKEY…
description: Hickory DNS versions hickory-net 0.26.0-beta.1 before 0.26.2 and hickory-proto 0.24.0 through 0.26.0-alpha.1 improperly compare DNSKEY public keys against DNSSEC trust anchors without verifying the DNSKEY record name. This flaw allows an attacker who can spoof or control DNS responses to replace a secure zone's DNSKEY RRset with the root zone's keys and use a large TTL to keep the malicious keys cached.
